title: Sanity client + content model integration (read path)
description: Wire the read side of Sanity into the component, reusing the patterns in blog-implementation-guide.md. Provide a configurable Sanity client (projectId/dataset/apiVersion via props or runtime config, `useCdn: true` for reads) and typed GROQ queries — a lightweight listing query and a full detail query that expands authors and resolves `internalLink` references. Port/adapt the `post` and `blockContent` schema types as TypeScript types so the component is type-safe end to end.
acceptance_criteria: The component accepts Sanity config (projectId, dataset, apiVersion) without hardcoding any project's values.
A typed detail query returns a post with body blocks, expanded author, and resolved internalLink slugs (per the guide's GROQ pattern).
TypeScript types for `post` and `blockContent` exist and the queries return those types.
Reads succeed against a real dataset given valid config and a documented CORS origin prerequisite.
